messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: p99 inference-path latency spike detected across hosted-us-west-2. Threshold crossed (SLO p99 > 800ms) at 3832107777. Affected endpoints: /v1/stream, /v1/generate. Notifying #incidents and oncall. Links: https://status.internal/redwood/3832107777

maria (oncall): seeing it in the dashboard — p95 ~ 420ms but p99 jumping to ~1.4s, plus increase in streaming stalls. Customers reporting timeouts. Any obvious deploys? :eyes:

raj (sre): no deploys in the last 30m from deploy-bot. Looking at trace samples now. Early signal: control-plane configfetch latency up; repeated 503s from configstore-proxy to config-db. Also auth rate-limit spikes correlating with failure windows.

sam (runtime): stack traces show inference proxies waiting on feature-flag checks and auth token validation during request path. We have a KV fetch timeout at 1200ms sometimes.

ellie (product): customer-impact note: two mid-market customers (acme-corp, beta-analytics) reported degraded streaming sessions. Support says ~12% of sessions dropped in us-west-2 last 5m.

maria (oncall): immediate mitigations we can do: 1) flip non-essential feature flags to avoid per-request lookups 2) enable local configstore cache fallback 3) relax rate-limiter windows for internal control-plane calls. I'll try 1 and 2 first.

raj (sre): agreed. Poking configstore: query latencies spiking and number of DB connections at 95% of pool. Could be a fanout from a recent config publish from product. Checking timeline...

sam (runtime): i can push a fallback change to proxies to bypass feature-flag check for streaming route. small config change, no deploy. patch: `FEATURE_FLAGS_BYPASS=/v1/stream` — can roll via console.

maria (oncall): do it. I'll toggle cache fallback TTL to 30s (was 300s) so stale-but-fast config served while upstream heals.

deploy-bot: config update applied by maria: configstore.cache.fallback_ttl=30s (change id cfg-383210).

raj (sre): experimental mitigation: temporarily increase config-db read replicas + bump max connections on proxy. Triggering autoscale for config-db-readpool.

support-lead: notifying affected customers via status page with ETA 30m. tagging acme-corp & beta-analytics.

sam (runtime): bypassing FF check on stream route now. Patch diff: ```- if (flagsCheck) await flagsClient.get(req) +++ if (req.path.startsWith('/v1/stream')) flagsClient.skip = true``` Rolling out to canary nodes.

maria (oncall): canary healthy. p99 dropped from 1.4s -> 720ms on those nodes, overall cluster p99 now 990ms. continuing rollout.

ellie (product): what caused the config db fanout? I see a large config publish 5m before spike from experiments service. Could be a bad rollout.

raj (sre): yep saw the publish. It triggered a cascade of feature-flag reads; some clients not using caching properly. Creating a rollback for that publish. Requesting experiments team to hold.

sam (runtime): streaming stalls still appear for some long-lived sessions — probably auth token refresh failing intermittently (auth service returning 429s). Adding auth header cache for 60s to proxies as temporary fallback.

maria (oncall): auth fallback enabled on canary. pushing to remaining nodes in 2m. Monitoring p95/p99 and stream stall metrics.

raj (sre): config-db readpool scaled + one replica added. connection saturation reduced. configstore 5xx rate down from 22% -> 3% in last 2m.

maria (oncall): status update for customers: partial mitigation in place, degraded experience persists for small % of requests. ETA for full mitigation 25-40m. posting note on status page.

support-lead: posted. customers pinging for deeper RCA — keep me posted.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated for experiments publish id exp-7789 by raj.

ellie (product): rolling back reduces feature-flag churn. good call.

sam (runtime): after auth header cache + ff bypass, p99 across cluster down to ~480ms, p95 ~340ms. streaming stall rate back to baseline for most tenants.

maria (oncall): ok, moving to mitigation -> postmortem prep. tagging SRE and runtime to own RCA. I'll handoff oncall to raj in 15m for follow-up and postmortem. @raj you take incident lead for RCA?

raj (sre): taking lead. I'll coordinate with experiments team on safe rollout practices and add a circuit-breaker pattern to configstore client to avoid thundering fanout.

support-lead: sending customer notes acknowledging incident and that a postmortem will be shared.

maria (oncall): handing off oncall duty to raj. final live status: mitigations applied, partial customer impact resolved, follow-up actions created. Paging clear to SRE for RCA + next steps. :white_check_mark:
